title: Existence of assembled finite etale local model
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $\{U_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ an etale cover, with $I$ in the universe of the schemes. Suppose that for each $i$ the restriction of $E$ transported to the small etale site of $U_i$ is represented by a finite etale $U_i$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Put $U=\coprod_iU_i$ with its codiagonal $U\to T$. There is a finite etale $U$-scheme $Q$ and an isomorphism between $E$ restricted to the site localized at $U$ and the lifted Yoneda presheaf of $Q$, precomposed with the equivalence from that localized site to the small etale site of $U$. No descent datum is asserted here.

proof.text: Use classical choice to select each finite etale Q_i from hrep, retaining its representation isomorphism. The choices only appear in this proof of existence, never in a definition.

Construct pi = Sigma.map(Q_i.obj.hom) explicitly. Each component square is a pullback: prove the preimage of the target coprojection open range is the source coprojection open range by sigmaMk surjectivity and sigma_iota_eq_iff, then apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback. Finiteness follows by target locality on sigmaOpenCover, transporting along the component pullback isomorphism. Etaleness follows by source locality of Sigma.desc of Q_i.obj.hom followed by target coprojections. Thus Q = Etale.mk pi with its proved IsFinite property is a finite etale object over U.

Apply etaleCoproduct_representation to the selected etale representatives to identify the transported E.over U with the lifted Yoneda presheaf of the explicit coproduct Q. Precompose this isomorphism with (Etale.overToEtale U).op and use the unit isomorphism of Etale.overEquiv U, whiskered with (E.over U).obj. This gives the required localized-site isomorphism and hence the existential conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03RV and 02W5; H3 stage 3: explicit coproduct construction, component pullbacks, finite/etale locality and site-equivalence transport proved in Lean; only disjoint-component representation assembly split off.

mathlib_searches.query: Local finite etale representatives of a sheaf assemble over a coproduct and induce a descent datum compatible with sections
An etale scheme representing restriction of a sheaf on the small etale site carries a descent datum compatible with sections
mathlib_searches.results: Pseudofunctor.isEquivalence_toDescentData, Scheme.Etale.forget, Scheme.smallEtaleTopology and GlueData.sheafValGluedMk; supporting interfaces only, no theorem with this localized small-site representation input.
Scheme.Etale, Etale.forgetFullyFaithful and finite-limit instances; no assembly or compatible descent theorem.

Mathlib Cover.sigma, IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc, Surjective.sigmaDesc_of_union_range_eq_univ and sigmaOpenCover; the source library overDescentDatum requires a presheaf on all schemes over T, not a small-site sheaf. No exact assertion.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Cover.sigma and surjectivity are used in the upper proof; the remaining steps require the two intermediate constructions.

from.place: Assembly of the local representatives over the coproduct of the cover

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocalModels_descentDatum_exists
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T)
    (hrep : ∀ i, ∃ Q : (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i).left.FiniteEtale,
      Nonempty (((Etale.overSheafEquiv (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)
        (Type (u + 1))).functor.obj (E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))).obj ≅
          uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj)) :
    let U := 𝒰.sigma.etalePrecoverageToEtale default
    ∃ (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale),
      Nonempty ((E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙
        uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj)
